title: Charity Fair with Good Neighbours KR
summary: Together with Good Neighbours KR we sold donated items — from handmade rings to paintings — for restoration work in Batken.
description: In partnership with Good Neighbours KR, we sold donated products, including accessories, handmade rings, candle stands, books, and paintings.
impact: Raised approximately 3,000 KGS for infrastructure restoration in Batken.
